title: Sordland/Turn04/Personal_Jogging
description: Monica and the Player jog through the capital to relax and think about things. This conversation is focused on dynamic environmental story telling and let's the player explore the inside of the city. It is meant to be a travelling experience to tie the player closer to the capital of the nation thus increasing immersion.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was early evening, still light o..."
entries.dialogueText: It was early evening, still light out with just a faint nip in the air. Franc was at a friend's and Deana was at an art class. Monica and I decided to go out for a walk before dinner.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica met me by the door, and we p..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica met me by the door, and we put on our coats and hats.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“One way or another, I want to cont..."
entries.dialogueText: “One way or another, I want to contribute to this country. No matter what happens.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica beamed at me, her face flush..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica beamed at me, her face flush with excitement.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Let’s get back to the house for di..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let’s get back to the house for dinner."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "What did our ideals really mean if..."
entries.dialogueText: What did our ideals really mean if they could be changed so easily? What about the people we idolize?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ionas had once fought hard and stro..."
entries.dialogueText: Ionas had once fought hard and strong against Soll’s judiciary reforms. But after years of the government blocking his every move, he gave up on his ideals and became a part of the administration.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we reached the river, we saw Ion..."
entries.dialogueText: As we reached the river, we saw Ionas Crona, the former Minister of Justice, walking in the opposite direction. I remembered that Nia Morgna used to be his Vice Minister. He gave us a quick nod of acknowledgement.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "This was why I had married her -- t..."
entries.dialogueText: This was why I had married her -- this passion and resolve. I should have anticipated that, sooner or later, she would join me in the political arena.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Otherwise, we will end up like...”"
entries.dialogueText: “Otherwise, we will end up like...”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“We are not weak, Anton. But we are..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are not weak, Anton. But we are only strong as long as we stand by our ideals. ”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Ewald Alphonso?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Ewald Alphonso?”
entries.menuText: “Ewald Alphonso?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Colonel Soll?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Colonel Soll?”
entries.menuText: “Colonel Soll?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Ionas Crona?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Ionas Crona?”
entries.menuText: “Ionas Crona?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Our former president tried his bes..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our former president tried his best. Yes, he failed, but his ideals weren't the reason."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Take another guess.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Take another guess.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Guess again.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Guess again.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Say what you will, but that relic..."
entries.dialogueText: “Say what you will, but that relic of the past was and frankly still is one of the most idealistic people in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Exactly. He backed down on his ide..."
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly. He backed down on his ideals and now everyone knows him for what he actually is...”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At that moment, we passed Ionas Cro..."
entries.dialogueText: At that moment, we passed Ionas Crona again. He was on a nearby bench, taking a smoke break after his own walk. Monica plastered on a big smile and greeted him, then turned back to me.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“...Spineless.”"
entries.dialogueText: “...Spineless.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We rose from the bench and started..."
entries.dialogueText: We rose from the bench and started making our way back home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "If that was how people remembered I..."
entries.dialogueText: If that was how people remembered Ionas, how would they remember me? Whatever he had done, whatever ideals he had lost, he must have had his reasons.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Would they remember me as a true pa..."
entries.dialogueText: Would they remember me as a true patriot? A reformer of the country? What would they write about me in the history books?

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Of course. Lead the way.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course. Lead the way.”
entries.menuText: “Of course. Lead the way.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was just starting to understand t..."
entries.dialogueText: I was just starting to understand the meaning of those words.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sun began to set over the horiz..."
entries.dialogueText: The sun began to set over the horizon, bathing the clouds in shades of orange and pink.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“So, how was your day?”"
entries.dialogueText: “So, how was your day?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Paperwork, endless meetings... the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Paperwork, endless meetings... the usual nightmare.”
entries.menuText: “Paperwork, endless meetings... the usual nightmare.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'd rather not say.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'd rather not say.”
entries.menuText: “I'd rather not say.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How was yours?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How was yours?”
entries.menuText: “How was yours?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“That good, was it?”"
entries.dialogueText: “That good, was it?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I don't know. I imagine some might..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know. I imagine some might find that stimulating."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Avoiding my question, are we? Very..."
entries.dialogueText: "Avoiding my question, are we? Very well.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What about your day?""
entries.dialogueText: “What about your day?"
entries.menuText: “What about your day?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Oh, it was fine. I caught up on so..."
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, it was fine. I caught up on some reading while the children were at school.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Evelyn also came round for tea. Sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Evelyn also came round for tea. She says hi. She was feeling rather low, though. Apparently she and Petr had a bit of a disagreement."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Apparently Petr had too much whisk..."
entries.dialogueText: “Apparently Petr had too much whiskey -- as usual -- and didn't behave when Evelyn's father was over for dinner yesterday.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I hope so. They always seemed so c..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope so. They always seemed so close.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That's Petr -- perpetually pickled..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's Petr -- perpetually pickled. I'll have a talk with him.”
entries.menuText: “That's Petr -- perpetually pickled. I'll have a talk with him.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's just a rough patch, love. The..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's just a rough patch, love. They'll be fine."
entries.menuText: “It's just a rough patch, love. They'll be fine."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“To be honest, I don't care.""
entries.dialogueText: “To be honest, I don't care."
entries.menuText: “To be honest, I don't care."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Who?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Who?”
entries.menuText: “Who?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Oh, Janice... Right.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, Janice... Right.”
entries.menuText: “Oh, Janice... Right.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“You remember, my friend from unive..."
entries.dialogueText: “You remember, my friend from university? We were in the Sordish Literature class together?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Neither the name nor the descriptio..."
entries.dialogueText: Neither the name nor the description rang a bell.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Anyway, she's been working as an e..."
entries.dialogueText: “Anyway, she's been working as an executive assistant at the Violet Pictures film studio."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Right, right, that Janice.""
entries.dialogueText: “Right, right, that Janice."
entries.menuText: “Right, right, that Janice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I still don't remember her, but go..."
entries.dialogueText: “I still don't remember her, but go on."
entries.menuText: “I still don't remember her, but go on."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""She recently became pregnant, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "She recently became pregnant, and asked her boss for paid maternity leave. And guess what?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“She was fired for it!”"
entries.dialogueText: “She was fired for it!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“After asking for maternity leave?..."
entries.dialogueText: “After asking for maternity leave? That's terrible.”
entries.menuText: “After asking for maternity leave? That's terrible.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So what?”"
entries.dialogueText: “So what?”
entries.menuText: “So what?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I know, I was beside myself when s..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know, I was beside myself when she told me. And that's not all.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“They immediately replaced her with..."
entries.dialogueText: “They immediately replaced her with a younger, less experienced man -- the son of an executive, no less.“

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“So what? She was sobbing, Anton. I..."
entries.dialogueText: “So what? She was sobbing, Anton. I asked her about what happened afterwards.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That is utterly ridiculous.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That is utterly ridiculous.”
entries.menuText: “That is utterly ridiculous.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So she called the First Lady to as..."
entries.dialogueText: “So she called the First Lady to ask for help?"
entries.menuText: “So she called the First Lady to ask for help?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nepotism, eh? They must have wante..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nepotism, eh? They must have wanted him in there all along."
entries.menuText: "Nepotism, eh? They must have wanted him in there all along."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I'm happy you agree with me.""
entries.dialogueText: “I'm happy you agree with me."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“She called a friend. She knows thi..."
entries.dialogueText: “She called a friend. She knows this is something I'm passionate about.“

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""That doesn't justify what they did..."
entries.dialogueText: "That doesn't justify what they did to her."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“As it happens, another friend work..."
entries.dialogueText: “As it happens, another friend works for a television station that's hiring secretaries, so I connected the two of them.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Terrific! Problem solved, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "Terrific! Problem solved, then."
entries.menuText: "Terrific! Problem solved, then."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That doesn't solve the deeper prob..."
entries.dialogueText: “That doesn't solve the deeper problem, though."
entries.menuText: “That doesn't solve the deeper problem, though."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I know that the mayor of Anrica, C..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know that the mayor of Anrica, Curtan Leste, will be delivering a speech at the annual opening of the Benfi festival.“

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I want our voice heard, and this f..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want our voice heard, and this festival is the time to do it. I just need your blessing as my husband and the President of Sordland.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You have my full support. Always.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You have my full support. Always.”
entries.menuText: “You have my full support. Always.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Absolutely not. Out of the questio..."
entries.dialogueText: “Absolutely not. Out of the question.”
entries.menuText: “Absolutely not. Out of the question.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sure, it's just a speech. What's t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sure, it's just a speech. What's the worst that can happen?”
entries.menuText: “Sure, it's just a speech. What's the worst that can happen?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't want you to step into poli..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't want you to step into politics.”
entries.menuText: “I don't want you to step into politics.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's not the right time. Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's not the right time. Sordland is facing too much political strife -- we'll have to deal with women's rights later.”
entries.menuText: “It's not the right time. Sordland is facing too much political strife -- we'll have to deal with women's rights later.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""This is why I love you. Thank you,..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is why I love you. Thank you, Anton -- you have no idea how much this means to me."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I won't let you down, Anton. Thank..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't let you down, Anton. Thank you.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica was silent for a while. When..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica was silent for a while. When she finally spoke, there was a chill in her voice.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“If that's truly how you feel, so b..."
entries.dialogueText: “If that's truly how you feel, so be it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We walked back home, neither of us..."
entries.dialogueText: We walked back home, neither of us looking at the other.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sorry, but I can't make Curtan Les..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sorry, but I can't make Curtan Leste angry."
entries.menuText: “Sorry, but I can't make Curtan Leste angry."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“What little trouble this causes in..."
entries.dialogueText: “What little trouble this causes in the short term is nothing compared to the lasting, positive change it will bring -- not just for women, but for all of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All right. If it means so much to..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. If it means so much to you, I'll make the arrangements for you to speak.”
entries.menuText: "All right. If it means so much to you.,I'll make the arrangements for you to speak."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't think so.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I don't think so.”
entries.menuText: “I don't think so.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“My wish is to take his place and d..."
entries.dialogueText: “My wish is to take his place and deliver the speech instead."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“It's not just a speech -- it's an..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's not just a speech -- it's an opportunity for real change. An end to centuries of oppression, and the beginning of a more equal society.“

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I don't understand. Isn't this som..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't understand. Isn't this something you care about as well?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Women in this country are still se..."
entries.dialogueText: "Women in this country are still seen as wives and mothers first, human beings second.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I know I'm not experienced. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know I'm not experienced. But I can do this. You have to trust me!“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My word is final. You will not mak..."
entries.dialogueText: “My word is final. You will not make the speech.”
entries.menuText: “My word is final. You will not do the speech.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I want to base the speech on women..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to base the speech on women's rights in Sordland. On the oppression and discrimination we face everyday, on the basis of our sex alone."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica's eyes were blazing with a f..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica's eyes were blazing with a fire I hadn't seen since we were students. She wanted this badly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But I had to be careful with my pro..."
entries.dialogueText: But I had to be careful with my promises.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I hope yours was better?""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope yours was better?"
entries.menuText: "I hope yours was better?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“You know Petr. What do you think o..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know Petr. What do you think of this?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Good. Evelyn seemed close to tears..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good. Evelyn seemed close to tears.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Maybe you should. He's your vice p..."
entries.dialogueText: “Maybe you should. He's your vice president after all. And they're our closest friends.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""A few years younger than me, red h..."
entries.dialogueText: "A few years younger than me, red hair, scar on her forehead? We had dinner with her and her husband once or twice."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“But she's been working there for y..."
entries.dialogueText: “But she's been working there for years without so much as a raise. Something is wrong with this, Anton. And that's not all.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: ""Of course. I'll lead the way.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. I'll lead the way."
entries.menuText: Lead the way yourself.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What's she nagging him about this..."
entries.dialogueText: “What's she nagging him about this time?"
entries.menuText: “What's she nagging him about this time?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“You know Evelyn hasn't been the sa..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know Evelyn hasn't been the same since what happened to her at Holsord Post last year.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“You remember -- how she got fired..."
entries.dialogueText: “You remember -- how she got fired for supporting Alphonso? Petr tried everything to get her job back, but it didn't work.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Petr's in the doghouse again? How'..."
entries.dialogueText: “Petr's in the doghouse again? How'd it happen?”
entries.menuText: “Petr's in the doghouse again? How'd it happen?”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""But enough about the Vecterns. I a..."
entries.dialogueText: "But enough about the Vecterns. I also spoke to Janice on the phone."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Maybe he didn't try hard enough.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Maybe he didn't try hard enough.”
entries.menuText: “Maybe he didn't try hard enough.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“She had it coming.”"
entries.dialogueText: “She had it coming.”
entries.menuText: “She had it coming.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“A sad day for journalism and free..."
entries.dialogueText: “A sad day for journalism and free speech in Sordland.”
entries.menuText: “A sad day for journalism and free speech in Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""How can you say that? It was a sad..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can you say that? It was a sad day for freedom of the press in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I don't think anything would have..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't think anything would have worked. It was a sad day for freedom of the press in Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I completely agree. A sad day inde..."
entries.dialogueText: “I completely agree. A sad day indeed.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Look at it from a cost standpoint...."
entries.dialogueText: “Look at it from a cost standpoint. Obviously, they don't want to lose money.”
entries.menuText: “Look at it from a cost standpoint. Obviously, they don't want to lose money.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I kept walking."
entries.dialogueText: I kept walking.
entries.menuText: Keep walking in silence.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“They're harassed at work, underpai..."
entries.dialogueText: “They're harassed at work, underpaid, blocked from positions of power... and those are the lucky ones!"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“The fact that there are still plac..."
entries.dialogueText: “The fact that there are still places in this country where little girls like Deana are denied the right to an education--”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Go on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Go on.”
entries.menuText: “Go on.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm sure the parents have their re..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sure the parents have their reasons.”
entries.menuText: “I'm sure the parents have their reasons.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes, and I will do what I can to c..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, and I will do what I can to change that.“
entries.menuText: “Yes, and I will do what I can to change that.“

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“What kind of reasons, Anton? What..."
entries.dialogueText: “What kind of reasons, Anton? What could justify this?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Poverty.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Poverty.”
entries.menuText: “Poverty.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Tradition.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Tradition.”
entries.menuText: “Tradition.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Then more work must be done to gra..."
entries.dialogueText: “Then more work must be done to grant everyone an affordable education. And in the meantime, these girls and women like Janice need someone to speak on their behalf. A role model. A successful woman."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“These backwards ideals are slowing..."
entries.dialogueText: “These backwards ideals are slowing down Sordland's transformation into a modern nation.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“These little girls and people like..."
entries.dialogueText: “These little girls and people like Janice need to have someone who can speak on their behalf. A role model. A successful woman.“

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Which brings me to my point.“"
entries.dialogueText: “Which brings me to my point.“

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“These little girls and people like..."
entries.dialogueText: “These little girls and people like Janice need someone to speak on their behalf. A role model. A successful woman.“

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""It can't just be you. These little..."
entries.dialogueText: "It can't just be you. These little girls and people like Janice need someone to speak on their behalf. A role model. A successful woman.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nonsense. We have our guards -- th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nonsense. We have our guards -- there's nothing to be afraid of. Let's go to Capitol Park.”
entries.menuText: “Nonsense. We have our guards -- there's nothing to be afraid of. Let's go to Capitol Park.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I was going to suggest we walk tow..."
entries.dialogueText: “I was going to suggest we walk towards Soll Square, but the guards told me it's been closed for yet another protest.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I wonder who they are protesting t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I wonder who they are protesting this time.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What does it matter? They are two..."
entries.dialogueText: “What does it matter? They are two sides of the same coin.”
entries.menuText: “What does it matter? They are two sides of the same coin.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Common thugs. I will make sure the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Common thugs. I will make sure they are punished.”
entries.menuText: “Common thugs. I will make sure they are punished.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Must be those damn communists agai..."
entries.dialogueText: “Must be those damn communists again.”
entries.menuText: “Must be those damn communists again.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The Young Sords are taking it too..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Young Sords are taking it too far.”
entries.menuText: “The Young Sords are taking it too far.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“In any case, where shall we go? I'..."
entries.dialogueText: “In any case, where shall we go? I'm not sure Capitol Park is a wise idea in this climate, either...

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You're right -- it's not worth the..."
entries.dialogueText: “You're right -- it's not worth the security risk. Let's stay inside the green perimeter.”
entries.menuText: “You're right -- it's not worth the security risk. Let's stay inside the green perimeter.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our favorite place for a stroll was..."
entries.dialogueText: Our favorite place for a stroll was the nearby Capitol Park, the largest green space in all of Holsord. Before the children were born, we had spent many an evening engaged in deep conversation along the riverside promenade.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Another favored path wound through..."
entries.dialogueText: Another favored path wound through the woods behind the presidential housing complex, to a private pond where the children could swim in summer. I was told that Soll himself had it built. The benefits of being president.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“All right. Let's go, then, before..."
entries.dialogueText: “All right. Let's go, then, before the children get home.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I agree. Let's go, then, before th..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree. Let's go, then, before the children get home.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I informed the guards about our rou..."
entries.dialogueText: I informed the guards about our route and we left the house.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I informed the guards about our rou..."
entries.dialogueText: I informed the guards about our route and we left the house.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards followed us with a black..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards followed us with a black Kadilla as we exited the gates. Walking briskly, we reached Capitol Park in minutes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards followed at a discreet d..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards followed at a discreet distance as we headed towards the walking trail.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we entered the woods, Monica bro..."
entries.dialogueText: As we entered the woods, Monica broke the silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we entered the park, Monica brok..."
entries.dialogueText: As we entered the park, Monica broke the silence.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I was going to suggest we walk tow..."
entries.dialogueText: “I was going to suggest we walk towards Soll Square, but the guards told me it's been closed because of the emergency act.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“There are so many police officers..."
entries.dialogueText: “There are so many police officers in the city now, it's starting to remind me of the twenties.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I wonder how long this will go on...."
entries.dialogueText: “I wonder how long this will go on.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They're protecting us against our..."
entries.dialogueText: “They're protecting us against our enemies.”
entries.menuText: “They're protecting us against our enemies.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“As long as it has to.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As long as it has to.”
entries.menuText: “As long as it has to.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I understand.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I understand.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“So you say. But I still don't like..."
entries.dialogueText: “So you say. But I still don't like seeing so many guns on the streets.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I know. It's unnerving to me too.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I know. It's unnerving to me too.”
entries.menuText: “I know. It's unnerving to me too.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Let's hope it has an effect and th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's hope it has an effect and the threat subsides.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leste was one of Sordland's most in..."
entries.dialogueText: Leste was one of Sordland's most influential politicians. He had started his career in Benfi before rising to power in Anrica. Benfi's current mayor had personally invited him to make the opening speech.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Replacing him with Monica would lik..."
entries.dialogueText: Replacing him with Monica would likely anger him -- probably not enough to cause a huge incident, but enough that he might use his influence over the conservatives to block me in the Assembly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When we arrived home, I called my s..."
entries.dialogueText: When we arrived home, I called my secretary Livia and asked her to inform Mr. Leste that Monica would be making the speech in his stead.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You were a damn communist yourself..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were a damn communist yourself, once upon a time."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You were one of those thugs yourse..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were one of those thugs yourself, once upon a time."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You didn't think that when you wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "You didn't think that when you were a Young Sord yourself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is different. A nastier breed.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is different. A nastier breed."
entries.menuText: "This is different. A nastier breed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I was young and stupid. I didn't k..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was young and stupid. I didn't know any better."
entries.menuText: "I was young and stupid. I didn't know any better."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Old grudges die hard, I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "Old grudges die hard, I see."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""The Anton I knew in university nev..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Anton I knew in university never would have said that."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You always did believe yourself to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You always did believe yourself to be above the fray."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Funny how becoming president chang..."
entries.dialogueText: "Funny how becoming president changes one's perspective."
entries.menuText: "Funny how becoming president changes one's perspective."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Aren't you glad you and I don't ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aren't you glad you and I don't have these kinds of quarrels?"
entries.menuText: "Aren't you glad you and I don't have these kinds of quarrels?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Being married to a shrew like her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Being married to a shrew like her would make anyone turn to the bottle."
entries.menuText: "Being married to a shrew like her would make anyone turn to the bottle."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica gave me a quick kiss on the..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica gave me a quick kiss on the cheek. We continued walking.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica didn't say anything. We kept..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica didn't say anything. We kept walking.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica gave me a sharp look. We kep..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica gave me a sharp look. We kept walking.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Can't her husband provide for the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Can't her husband provide for the both of them while she raises the child?"
entries.menuText: “Can't her husband provide for the both of them while she raises the child?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“But why should she have to lose he..."
entries.dialogueText: “But why should she have to lose her job? Something is wrong with this, Anton. And that's not all."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""So you're finally starting to see..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you're finally starting to see things my way!"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Exactly! I knew you'd be on the sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly! I knew you'd be on the same page."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You still don't understand, do you?""
entries.dialogueText: "You still don't understand, do you?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Really, Anton? After everything we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really, Anton? After everything we've talked about?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were right in front of one of th..."
entries.dialogueText: We were right in front of one of the park benches that lined the river. Monica gestured to it, and we sat down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We had reached the pond at the end..."
entries.dialogueText: We had reached the pond at the end of the trail. A park bench overlooked the water. Monica gestured to it, and we sat down.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Does it have to be at the festival..."
entries.dialogueText: “Does it have to be at the festival? Why can't you make your speech another time?"
entries.menuText: “Does it have to be at the festival? Why can't you make your speech another time?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“I don't understand. After all I've..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't understand. After all I've done to support you, you can't support me on this?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Women belong in the home, not in p..."
entries.dialogueText: “Women belong in the home, not in politics."
entries.menuText: “Women belong in the home, not in politics."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“It has to be now. Thousands go to..."
entries.dialogueText: “It has to be now. Thousands go to this festival, and millions watch the speeches at home. Sordland's women can't wait any longer!“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just outside the gate, I glimpsed I..."
entries.dialogueText: Just outside the gate, I glimpsed Ionas Crona, the former Minister of Justice, walking towards Capitol Park. I remembered that Nia Morgna used to be his Vice Minister. He didn't seem to notice us as he walked by.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Monica smiled.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You know, I believe I will.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know, I believe I will."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was early evening, still light o..."
entries.dialogueText: It was early evening, still light out with just a faint nip in the air. Franc was at a friend's and Deana was at an art class. Monica and I decided to go out for a walk before dinner.

entries.title: Narrator: "It was early evening, still light o..."
entries.dialogueText: It was early evening, still light out with just a faint nip in the air. Franc was at a friend's and Deana was at an art class. Monica and I decided to go out for a walk before dinner.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Remember my time with the Sordish..."
entries.dialogueText: “Remember my time with the Sordish League of Women in university? You supported me then. I'm asking you to support me now.“

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Serge said he found something in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Serge said he found something in the car after bringing it up from the garage."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""A letter. Hand-folded, no envelope..."
entries.dialogueText: "A letter. Hand-folded, no envelope. Just the initials E.M. on the corner."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How’d it get there?""
entries.dialogueText: "How’d it get there?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's unusual.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's unusual."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""That’s the thing. He swore no one’..."
entries.dialogueText: "That’s the thing. He swore no one’s been near the car since last night."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""But he passed it on after I read i..."
entries.dialogueText: "But he passed it on after I read it, and the Presidential Guard took it -- standard protocol -- apparently. They check for poison, residue, that sort of thing."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Someone got close enough to leave..."
entries.dialogueText: "Someone got close enough to leave a note in my car?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You read it first? What did it say?""
entries.dialogueText: "You read it first? What did it say?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Probably just someone trying to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Probably just someone trying to mess with us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Should’ve let them take it before..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should’ve let them take it before you opened it."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I only remember parts... but they’..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only remember parts... but they’re hard to forget."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Maybe.""
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I know. I hesitated. But it was al..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know. I hesitated. But it was already open."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I didn’t get far before passing it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn’t get far before passing it on, but enough."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""The Palace was built on lies... fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palace was built on lies... from the beginning. Not by the divine, nor the people, but by intent."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I have borne the same burden. I on..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have borne the same burden. I only understood when it came for E.A."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""And then something cryptic: ‘Burn..."
entries.dialogueText: "And then something cryptic: ‘Burn the old. Through fire, the new can be born. Until then, an interregnum will bring pain... and the prairie will strangle itself.’"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let the Guard finish their sweep...."
entries.dialogueText: "Let the Guard finish their sweep. I will check on it sometime."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""E.M. knew too much. If they got th..."
entries.dialogueText: "E.M. knew too much. If they got that close, they could be watching everything."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe they’re warning me. Or warni..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe they’re warning me. Or warning me off."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Already asked. They’ll send it if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Already asked. They’ll send it if it clears."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""That’s what I thought. It didn’t s..."
entries.dialogueText: "That’s what I thought. It didn’t sound like a threat. It sounded like regret."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I’ve been thinking the same. That..."
entries.dialogueText: "I’ve been thinking the same. That letter wasn’t intercepted... it was delivered."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe it’s just some bored revolut..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe it’s just some bored revolutionary kid, trying to sound important."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Maybe. But if it was a joke, it wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe. But if it was a joke, it was a sharp one."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Anyway, we should enjoy the run. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anyway, we should enjoy the run. It's one of the few things we have just for *us*"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We jogged on for a few quiet minute..."
entries.dialogueText: We jogged on for a few quiet minutes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A sleek cat leapt across the path a..."
entries.dialogueText: A sleek cat leapt across the path ahead of us. Silver fur, one blue eye, one green, an Agn cat, no doubt. After a brief look it then disappeared into a hedge with a flick of its marbled tail.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I had two like that when I was you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had two like that when I was young. My mother raised them. They used to nap in the windows all day and vanish at night like little ghosts."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I always thought you looked most a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always thought you looked most at peace when you talked about that house."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I remember you told me one used to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I remember you told me one used to sit on your piano stool while you practiced... like it was judging your technique."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don’t think I ever had a place l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don’t think I ever had a place like that. Maybe that’s why I never learned how to miss it."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Then we’ll make one. No matter wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then we’ll make one. No matter what happens around us, we still can. And if not for us, for the kids."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""It did. Even when things were tens..."
entries.dialogueText: "It did. Even when things were tense... there was still breath in it. Like it was holding space for us."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""He was merciless. Always left the..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was merciless. Always left the room when I hit the wrong notes."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Together. That’s all that matters..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together. That’s all that matters in the end."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The past is the past. We have a gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The past is the past. We have a great future to look forward to. One that we can build."
